environmentNotes: Scope: 25 inventory cases + 3 gap cases (TC_ASET_010, TC_INV_005, TC_PROF_013) = 28. Excluded and not counted (approval not granted): TC_ACC_004 (logout), TC_ASET_002/003/007/009 (password change, logout all devices), TC_ASET_004/005/006 (no live validation exists - rule errors appear only after tapping Update, which could change the shared QA password), TC_PROF_002-006/009/010/011 (saving profile), TC_NSET_002/005/006 (saving preferences, OS permissions), TC_PRIV_003-005 (permission settings). Blocked (genuine dependency): TC_ACC_006 (no corporate account), TC_RWD_003 (no completed trips). No profile, password, notification or permission change was saved; Cancel/back used everywhere. Personal data (name, phone, email, address, invoice PDF) not captured; screenshots cropped.

cases.actual: Account tab: Welcome Back - <Name>! header with Regular Client badge; menu Personal Information, Account Settings, Invoices & Receipts, Booking History, My Support Tickets, Rewards & Loyalty, Notifications, Privacy & Security, Logout - each with subtitle and chevron.
Booking History opens the bookings screen (title Booking History, Today/Week/Month, Live/Upcoming/Completed/Inquired 18) with the Ride tab highlighted; back arrow returns to Account.
My Support Tickets opens Help > My Support History (title My Support Tickets) with the empty-state text; Help tab highlighted.

Logout -> Logout Confirmation (Are you sure you want to logout? CANCEL / LOGOUT); CANCEL (single tap after live-stream check) closes the dialog and the user stays logged in on the Account screen. LOGOUT was not tapped (not approved).
Regular Client badge shown for the regular QA account (consistent). The corporate side of the check needs a corporate user, which is not available; corporate badge could not be verified.

Personal Information (Edit User Information) prefilled with account data: Name *, Email Address (greyed/read-only), Phone Number *, Address (location field), I need a GST invoice for my bookings checkbox, Submit and Cancel. (Not captured - personal data.)

Address opens the Address picker (Search For A Location, Use Current Location); searching majestic and selecting Majestic updates the Address field to Majestic, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Form not submitted (Cancel used).
Ticking I need a GST invoice reveals GSTIN Number *, Legal Name (as per GST) *, State *; unticking hides them. (Stored GST values are invalid - see TC_PROF_013.)
Edited Name (appended qa) and Address (Majestic) -> Cancel -> reopen Personal Information: original Name and Address retained; nothing saved.

cases.scenario: Previously saved GST details are valid when the GST section is reopened
cases.preconditions: Account with GST details saved earlier
cases.steps: 1. Open Personal Information 2. Tick I need a GST invoice 3. Read stored GSTIN, Legal Name, State
cases.expected: Stored GSTIN is a valid 15-character GSTIN whose state code matches State; Legal Name is a name
cases.actual: Stored GSTIN is s#_&+( (6 characters with symbols), Legal Name 12838838 (digits), State Uttar Pradesh - invalid GST data was accepted and saved earlier, so GSTIN format validation is not enforced on save.

Account Settings: Current, New, Confirm Password fields each with an eye toggle; Update / Cancel; Password Requirements list (8+ chars, upper & lower, number, special); Security section with Logout From All Devices.
Eye toggle on New Password masks that field only; Confirm Password stays visible - toggles work independently. (Default unmasked state logged as TC_ASET_010.)

cases.scenario: Password fields are masked by default
cases.steps: 1. Type into New Password 2. Type into Confirm Password 3. Observe before touching the eye icons
cases.expected: Typed characters are masked (dots) until the eye icon is tapped
cases.actual: New Password (abcdefg) and Confirm Password (xyz) displayed in plain text by default; tapping the eye masks them, so the default state is inverted. Real passwords would be shown on screen while typing.

Invoices & Receipts: All / This Month / Last 3 Months tabs; Summary (Total Spent, Total Trips, Average per Trip); invoice cards with ID, status chip, date range, amount, trip type, Download PDF / View Invoice. Empty state not shown because invoices exist for this account.

All: Rs 42,950 / 10 trips (INV-78..). This Month: identical. Last 3 Months: Rs 93,100 / 10 trips / avg Rs 9,310 starting at INV-70 - higher than All and missing the October invoices INV-71..78. Summary appears to cover only the 10 loaded invoices, so period totals are wrong.

Download PDF on INV-78 (PAID) offers Open with (Edge / Drive PDF Viewer); opened once in Drive: INV-78.pdf Cancelled Invoice Details with invoice no., booking inquiry ID 571, trip cost Rs 8,000, refund Rs 8,000 - matches the cancellation. (Not captured - PDF shows name, phone, email.)
Average per Trip = Total Spent / Total Trips in every period (42,950/10 = 4,295; 93,100/10 = 9,310); no divide-by-zero. (Which invoices are counted is wrong - TC_INV_002/TC_INV_005.)

cases.scenario: Invoice list shows the correct trip type and distinguishes cancellation invoices
cases.preconditions: Cancelled Transfer inquiries with cancellation invoices (INV-77, INV-78)
cases.steps: 1. Open Invoices & Receipts 2. Read INV-78 card 3. View Invoice
cases.expected: Card shows Transfer and marks it as a cancellation; payment status and amount match the cancellation invoice
cases.actual: INV-78 card shows Local - Sedan, PAID, Rs 0 while View Invoice shows Trip Type Transfer, Trip Status Cancelled, Payment Method Cash, Paid, Rs 0 and the PDF refunds Rs 8,000; INV-77 card Local - Sedan UNPAID Rs 1,600 (Transfer cancellation penalty on an unpaid inquiry). Cancellation invoices are counted as trips/spend in the summary.
Rewards & Loyalty: Trips Done 02, Collected Points 02, user card with tier badge, text You are 6 trips away from unlocking Gold Status, progress bar Silver Status -> Gold Status.
Trips Done 02 although Booking History shows Completed 0 (no completed trips); progress bar is ~75% towards Gold while the text says 6 trips away. OBS-25 still present.
Tier upgrade needs trips to be completed; no trip can be completed in QA without payment (not approved) and operator completion, so the threshold cannot be reached.
Tier badge reads JUSTELITE SILVER (likely Just Elite / Elite Silver) - misspelled tier name.
Notifications (Booking Updates): Email, SMS, Push, WhatsApp (with Enable WhatsApp button), Offers & Discounts, Loyalty Updates (all on), Newsletter (off); Save Preferences button at the bottom.
Toggled Newsletter on, left with back arrow without saving, reopened: Newsletter is off - unsaved change discarded (no prompt).
Enable WhatsApp tapped twice (waited 8-10 s each): nothing happens - no WhatsApp/consent opt-in flow, no browser, no message.

Privacy & Security: Privacy Policy link (Read our privacy policy); Permissions - Location Access (For pickup/drop location suggestions) and Camera Access (For profile photo & document upload) toggles with descriptions (both off).
Privacy Policy opens full in-app text (1. What this policy covers, entities, grievance officer, 2. What this policy covers...), scrolls, back arrow returns to Privacy & Security.
No account deletion option in Privacy & Security, Account Settings or the Account menu (only Logout / Logout From All Devices). OBS-26 still present (Google Play account-deletion requirement).
